title: Settings Change Ledger
changes: Added append-only Settings change-event construction with stable event IDs and duplicate rejection.
Added actor, source, timestamp, company scope, exact storage key and optional external authorization reference provenance.
Added automatic redaction of before/after values for registry entries marked sensitive.
Reused the canonical Settings value validator from the Pass 4 resolution engine to prevent validation drift.
Preserved settings-as-configuration semantics: ledger records and actor identity never grant runtime authority.
Updated the persistent 30-pass roadmap to record Pass 5 completion.
